scope.definition: Publicly verifiable distributions, executable entry points, bundled agent surfaces, mirrors and registry/index listings that can reasonably be tied to hypurrquant/perp-cli.
rules: The official hypurrquant/perp-cli repository and its package metadata are primary evidence.
Source is already public under MIT; no decompilation is necessary to recover the official TypeScript source.
Acquisition scripts perform unauthenticated public GET/git fetch only and never execute downloaded package code.
Private keys, API keys, cookies, bearer tokens, wallet signatures and authenticated traffic are out of scope.

notes: Current source tree exposes CLI, MCP server, guardrail entry point, exchange adapters, strategy/risk/funds logic and a bundled agent skill.
Latest observed main commit is later than the v0.13.0 release tag and contains post-release numeric-validation hardening.
Package.json publishes dist/ and skills/ and exposes three bin entry points.
The acquisition script resolves the tarball URL from npm registry metadata instead of invoking npm lifecycle scripts.

official_components.name: perp
notes: Commander-based multi-DEX CLI with structured JSON/NDJSON output, dry-run and wallet/signing support.

official_components.name: perp-mcp
notes: Current source file describes advisor mode and says it does not execute trades directly; it exposes public market reads plus account/advisor functionality.
External indexes and older README snapshots may report different tool counts; treat source at the pinned commit as authoritative.

official_components.name: perp-guardrail
notes: Third executable published by package.json at v0.13.0.
Bundled in the npm package and installable into Claude Code/Cursor/Codex/Gemini-style agent environments.
Repository/package metadata is older than current upstream; do not treat it as source of truth for 0.13.x behavior.
Historical Perpetual Protocol CLI. Similar command name, different package, codebase, authorship and protocol scope.

negative_findings.qualification: No first-party Android package or APK distribution was identified in the official repository/package/documented install surfaces.
No first-party iOS package was identified in the official repository/package/documented install surfaces.
The project includes CLI/terminal/dashboard-related code, but no separately distributed native desktop application was verified.
No official browser-extension distribution was verified.
